ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 35% high-intensity white pixels to 65% low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous white region on the distal upper half with dark peripheral mottling; right lobe exhibits a smaller distal white patch containing a prominent dark circular focal spot at its center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 5-12 units along the left lobe boundary; the right lobe trailing edge is intermittently occluded by water spray and foam.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; distinct circular high-contrast dark cluster on the right lobe white patch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible within the white pigmented region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular physical morphology at the distal lobe tips; distinct circular pigmentation anomaly or scar on the right lobe white patch.
other_distinctive_markers: The left lobe distal tip features a unique narrow, elongated protrusion forming a 'hook-like' geometric profile.
